subject: @abh/core bounded Tool JSON output staging through host-installed ObjectStorePort
coverage: data.object_artifacts is tenant-isolated, manifest-registered and least-privileged
inline artifacts up to 64 KiB retain their previous transactional behavior
object-backed JSON output is bounded between 64 KiB and 256 KiB
T1 persists staged metadata before the external put
put completion is read back and SHA-256 verified before publication
T2 atomically binds the stored object and publishes the Available artifact
tool terminal CAS and paid reservation settlement remain atomic
owner, source, media type, region and retention bindings are rechecked
tracked or failed storage keeps the tool pending and its charge held
inline reads cannot substitute for an object-backed artifact
authorization, purpose and tenant isolation are enforced
pre-read and post-read authorization rechecks proxy object content
full proxy reads verify exact length and SHA-256
range proxy reads enforce endpoints, response range and returned byte count
tombstone or metadata drift between port calls fails closed
limits: production cloud or remote ObjectStore adapters remain host-installed
orphan cleanup for abandoned staged artifacts remains open
binary media staging remains out of scope for this tool JSON path
